gate_agreement_line.claim: the gradient-free control stands within control_resolution(search) = d^2 / 2 of the loss's least in ln mu on data linear in mu, and the line is the grid's own (tight)

prediction.unit: the worst |ln(control / least)| over 4,001 truths, as a share of d^2 / 2 (5.53e-4 on the register's range, 7.35e-4 on (0.01, 2.5))
prediction.why: the loss in ln mu is C (e^x - e^x*)^2 / 2 for any data linear in mu, L''' = 3 L'' at the least, so the three-point vertex's error is at most (L'''/6L'') d^2 = d^2/2, attained where the least sits on a grid point

gate_agreement_line.metric: the worst gap over the truths, against d^2/2

control.plant: a line nine tenths as wide
control.resolution: the derivation's next order, under 1e-4 of the line

gate_agreement_line.if_wrong: a gap past d^2/2: the control's grid or its clamp is not what the derivation assumes

gate_b1_fit_verdict_fresh.claim: at fresh seeds, every sliding draw reads identified and no never-sliding draw does (they read bounded below only)
gate_b1_fit_verdict_fresh.case: probe/gates261.py fit (fit_friction through built.run), W2B_PLANT=1 the never-sliding data

prediction.unit: never-sliding draws reading bounded below only, of 20 (and none identified); sliding draws reading identified, 20 of 20
prediction.why: the sliding draws' |estimate - control| is at most d^2/2 = 7.35e-4 of it on this search (the derivation), within the line before the standard error is added; the never-sliding draws' loss is flat above the threshold, so no standard error and never identified

control.plant: the data: a block under its threshold

gate_b1_fit_verdict_fresh.if_wrong: a sliding draw confounded: its data are curved in mu (a slip that stops) or the path did not reach the least; a never-sliding draw identified: the verdict overclaims
gate_b1_fit_verdict_fresh.cannot_discriminate_if: a draw within the curvature step (1e-3) of the threshold

gate_m2_rolling_passivity_fresh.claim: rolling resistance never injects at fresh seeds: the clean suite raises nothing, its sign flipped is raised on every run

control.resolution: the suite's guard and residual lines

gate_m2_rolling_passivity_fresh.if_wrong: a clean run flagged: the deeper share or a draw past the solve's reach; a planted run missed: the acts premise
gate_m2_rolling_passivity_fresh.cannot_discriminate_if: rolling resistance inside its limit on every draw
